common.style_usage: the exact Stardew Valley style of these crafted machines: one tile wide and two tall, square-on, warm wood, dark coloured outlines
common.reference_usage: shape: a small workbench, one tile wide and two tall, with an empty picture frame standing upright in a clamp on top; keep this size and layout

framers_bench.description: a Stardew Valley crafted machine, one object alone on a transparent background, one tile wide and two tall, square-on from the front, dark coloured (not black) outlines: a framer's bench, a small sturdy wooden workbench with a drawer, a little brass vice clamped on top holding an empty wooden picture frame upright, a few tacks and a tack hammer beside it
